headline: Major Economies Criticize New U.S. Tariffs Following Excess Production Probe
summary: Major economies including China and the EU criticized proposed U.S. tariffs of up to 20% after Washington concluded its investigation into alleged excess production.
why: U.S. trade policies and retaliatory measures by trading partners can disrupt global supply chains and heighten international trade tensions.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Imposing import duties affects trade flows and prompts friction with major trade partners.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: The introduction of tariffs up to 20% following a trade probe sparked immediate pushback from major economic powers like China and the EU, raising concerns over escalating global trade tensions.
